verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a payments platform with an API and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents API credentials with roles, permissions or least-privilege scoping. The client key (docs-26) is a single client-side key per environment tied to allowed origins, test credentials (docs-15) are for testing transactions, and the MCP server mention (docs-14) says nothing about credential scoping. All of these are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
